text.characters:
We sincerely thank people living with dementia, family carers, community organisations, and aged care workers who contributed to the co-design and development of iSupport-D.
We also acknowledge the contributions of dementia carers in Australia, Indonesia, New Zealand, and Vietnam, whose experiences helped inform the development of both the e-DiVA platform and iSupport-D.
